title: 第5章 s级火焰掌控者第6章 美女与野兽
slug: 末世我的女人有亿点强
lines: 林羽看向脑海中的属性面板。
【天赋：s级烈焰掌控者：进化中……】
【火焰解锁形态：烈焰，龙之炎（解锁中……）】
“s级火焰掌控者，龙之炎的形态下，应该可以和前世那些最强序列的进化者争锋了。”
林羽心中涌出浓烈的战意。
前世的他，在天赋觉醒到s级后，也才堪堪挤进顶级进化者而已。
想要追赶最强序列的进化者，差距依然很大。
现在不一样了，他进化成了s级天赋的龙之炎，可比上一世强太多了。
s级火焰掌控者！
这已经脱离了最基础的元素系天赋了，可以算上特殊天赋中顶尖的存在。
“丧尸雨马上就要来了！”
林羽抬头望着天空，红色的进化之雨已经稀少。
当进化之雨停止，整个世界的天空，就会出现很多的次元裂缝，掉落无数的丧尸空投。
到那个时候，丧尸横行，真正的进化序幕缓缓拉开。
物竞天择，适者生存。
弱者，将会被淘汰！
“现在，先去弄点吃的吧，觉醒消耗了太多能量了。”
林羽穿好衣服，朝着山脚奔去。
他最重要的事，还是尽快和妹妹汇合。
只不过马上丧尸将会大批量掉落，这个时间不能贸然行动。
“也不知道妹妹会觉醒什麽天赋。”
林羽想到这，边跑边拿出手机拨了过去。
电话瞬间被接通，传来了林小幽略微不安的声音。
林羽心中心中一惊。
“哥，你是不是知道什麽？这个世界是不是要变了，我总感觉要有什麽大事要发生。”
林羽闻言，心情沉重。
“傻丫头，别担心，一切有哥哥在。”林羽轻声安慰。
“还有二十多分钟，全世界的天空中会掉落很多很多的丧尸！”
content_en:
Lin Yu looked at the attribute panel in his mind.
[Magic power: 6500]
【Strength: 66】
[Physique: 36]
[Speed: 25]
【Spirit: 115】
[Talent: S-level Flame Controller: Evolving...]
[Unlocked form of flame: raging flame, dragon flame (unlocking...)]
"The S-class flame controller, in the form of dragon flames, should be able to compete with the most powerful evolvers in the previous life."
Lin Yu's heart surged with strong fighting spirit.
In his previous life, after his talent awakened to S level, he could only squeeze into the top level of evolution.
If you want to catch up with the evolvers of the strongest sequence, the gap is still huge.
It's different now. He has evolved into an S-level talent called Dragon Flame, which is much stronger than in his previous life.
S-class flame controller!
This is no longer the most basic elemental talent, and can be considered the top among special talents.
"The zombie rain is coming soon!"
Lin Yu looked up at the sky, and the red rain of evolution was already scarce.
When the rain of evolution stops, many dimensional cracks will appear in the sky of the entire world, and countless zombies will drop from the sky.
By that time, zombies will be rampant, and the real evolution will slowly begin.
Natural selection, survival of the fittest.
The weak will be eliminated!
"Now, let's go get something to eat. Awakening consumes too much energy."
Lin Yu put on his clothes and ran towards the foot of the mountain.
The most important thing for him was to reunite with his sister as soon as possible.
It's just that zombies will be dropped in large quantities soon, so you can't act rashly at this time.
"I don't know what talent my sister will awaken."
Lin Yu thought of this, took out his cell phone and called while running.
"Brother~"
The phone was connected instantly, and Lin Xiaoyou's slightly uneasy voice came.
Lin Yu was shocked.
"Brother, do you know something? Is the world going to change? I always feel like something big is going to happen."
Lin Yu felt heavy when he heard this.
"Silly girl, don't worry, my brother is here for everything." Lin Yu comforted softly.
"In more than twenty minutes, many zombies will fall from the sky all over the world!"
